title: Card Refunded Amount on a Returned Unit — Finch Circle and Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards
content:
**Rule.** When Finch Circle Loyalty Program points are taken back on a refunded return, the card refunded amount is the qualifying amount on the unit's purchase points entries. When a merchandise credit for the unit was posted to the member's Marlowe & Finch card, the card refunded amount is that credit less the sales tax refunded; when the refund was issued to a Merchandise Credit Card, it is none (0); otherwise it stays the qualifying amount on the unit's purchase points entries.

The merchandise credit is read from the transactions of the member's Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, as a merchandise credit naming the returned unit's purchase record. The sales tax refunded and the refund destination are read from the refund record of the return.

| Records show | Card refunded amount |
|---|---|
| a merchandise credit for the unit posted to the member's Marlowe & Finch card | that credit less the sales tax refunded |
| no such credit, refund issued to a Merchandise Credit Card | none (0) |
| neither | the qualifying amount on the unit's purchase points entries |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A merchandise credit of 108.00 for the unit posted to the member's Store Card, with 8.00 of sales tax refunded: card refunded amount 100.00.
- The refund went to a Merchandise Credit Card and nothing was credited to the card: 0.
- The unit was refunded in cash and no card credit exists; its purchase points entries carry 64.00: 64.00.
